Changelog:
Housekeeping release. 

Fixed:
- Fixed an issue where there were multiple instances of final build files.
- Fixed an issue where release notes were not handed off to the ingame installer
- Fixed a version mismatching issue.
- Fixed an issue where the mainwindow discarded its own GUI.

Changed:

Punchline: Priority-sorted gathering node tracker. No automation.
Description: Shows a priority-sorted list of active and upcoming gathering nodes from your wishlist, using FFXIV's deterministic weather and Eorzea clock. Read-only by design: no automated movement or gathering.
